name: Stormborn Grand Tetons
description: Snow-covered peaks rise through layers of cloud while the valley rests in deep shadow. Light breaks across the mountain faces, revealing sharp ridges before the weather draws another veil. The Tetons carry a wild presence here: immense, restless, and worth standing still for.
